summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package's package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs is obfuscated (hex-mangled identifiers, string-map dispatcher) and, on npm install, detects the host platform/arch/musl, downloads a Bun runtime binary from GitHub releases (pinned to bun-v1.3.13), extracts it, chmods it executable, and immediately execFileSync's the Bun binary against a sibling math_init.js. math_init.js is a ~727KB single-line Bun-CJS bundle carrying obfuscator.io-style artifacts: a rotating string-array shuffler, a custom-alphabet base85-like decoder, hex-named identifiers, and a ~1000-entry constant table used to reconstruct URLs and API sinks at runtime, so destinations are not statically visible. The package's advertised purpose is a Babel plugin that rewrites Linaria css`` tags to undefined; that transform has no need of a second language runtime or of executing a 727KB obfuscated bundle at install time. package.json also claims author 'Christophe Hurpeau' and repository ornikar/babel-plugin-linaria-css-to-undefined, matching a legitimate upstream Babel plugin that does not ship setup.mjs, math_init.js, or a preinstall hook — the lib/index.js appears reused as cover while the dropper is smuggled via preinstall.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
